web_evidence.note: This authorized Penguin Random House German excerpt spans the prologue through chapter 7. It sustains third-person narration across Talanov, Campus operatives, Edgar Nõlvak, Jack Ryan Jr., Haldane, and President Ryan; first-person material is visibly delimited as dialogue or direct thought. It also places the Fort Ord sentence in Ding Chavez's speech.

search_log: Searched “Command Authority” with Tom Clancy/Mark Greaney plus excerpt, first chapter, and publisher-domain terms; found the English retail preview and an 83-page Penguin Random House German excerpt.
Opened the Penguin Random House German PDF and inspected its prologue and chapters 1–7, including multiple focal characters, direct thoughts, dialogue boundaries, and the Fort Ord passage.

Searched the title with point of view, narrator, third person, first person, alternating point of view, epistolary, diary, and frame narrative; no credible source described a sustained first-person, second-person, or alternating structure.
Opened the US Penguin Random House catalog page; its Read Sample text was not exposed, and the synopsis was treated as nondiagnostic.

Searched exact text for “I inherited curiosity from my Dad” and “I had a drill instructor back at Fort Ord”; the authorized translated excerpt confirmed the latter as Ding Chavez's dialogue, while the former's exact local context remained unavailable.
person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages repeatedly show externally focalized characters, and the Tier A publisher excerpt independently sustains third-person narration across the prologue and seven chapters with several focal characters and settings. The excerpt demonstrates that locally visible first-person language can occur inside character dialogue or direct thought; it specifically resolves q00768 as Ding Chavez's speech. The isolated first-person q00756 remains locally unresolved because its boundaries are missing, but it is not credible evidence of a controlling first-person narrator against the sustained third-person structure. No research indicated alternating, epistolary, or second-person sections. The main residual uncertainty is only the exact local form of q00756, not the book-level person.
